title: NetKeeper: Enhancing Network Resilience with Autonomous Network Configuration Update on Traffic Patterns and Anomalies
problem: Networks lack autonomous mechanisms to respond to traffic anomalies and pattern changes by dynamically reconfiguring settings, resulting in prolonged degradation or failures when unexpected traffic conditions occur.
motivation: Autonomous network adaptation is critical for maintaining service availability and performance resilience against unpredictable traffic anomalies.
method: NetKeeper continuously watches network traffic and automatically detects anomalies—unexpected shifts in how data flows. When an anomaly is spotted, it reconfigures the network on its own (adjusting routing rules, queue management, and resource allocation) to handle the new conditions without manual intervention.
key_novelty: The system automatically adjusts network settings when traffic patterns change unexpectedly, without human intervention.
contributions: Autonomous network configuration update framework responding to traffic patterns and anomalies
Real-time anomaly detection mechanism for network traffic
Evaluation demonstrating improved network resilience and reduced recovery time

metrics.other: network resilience, recovery time, anomaly detection accuracy

primary_theme: Autonomous network resilience via dynamic configuration adaptation
